sm.run: committee run of 2026-09-26 on the shipped sources (sm_view)

stage_runs.note: the sm, em_matching and fusion blocks come from the committee runs listed under stages (written_at: the run's metrics.json timestamp); norm: see stage_sources

norm.scoring_note: the normalization score is the accuracy on the normalization test set, not schema conformance
norm.committee_versions_note: no committee_versions.norm entry: the block is not a committee-runner output; validate_variant runs a variant's norm stage only once measure_baseline has recorded committee_versions.norm for the base task, so that the variant and base norm blocks share a scoring surface

stage_sources.note: norm: accuracies on the normalization test set (see per_stage.norm.source)

metric_aliases.why: the generator's readers (build_statistics, analyze_monotonicity / lib.monotonicity, the report writers) key the norm stage on macro_f1; on this surface the values are cell accuracies on the normalization test set, not F1

source.measurement: normalization test set of the task (split=test, list_form), one accuracy per member = correct cells / all test cells (identity + transformations); the values behind the paper's Table 12 Norm. mean and ceiling

committee_norm.json.mode: shipped lock, else chosen by the committee at the first level (Table 12 setting)
